askUserQuestions.c0: Ordered list of questions to ask. 2–5 options per question is recommended.
askUserQuestions.c1: Controlled index of the active question.
askUserQuestions.c3: Called when the active question changes.
askUserQuestions.c4: Controlled answers map keyed by question id.
askUserQuestions.c7: Called after the last question is answered or submitted.
askUserQuestions.c8: Called when the user clicks Skip on a question.
askUserQuestions.c9: Label for the skip control in the header.
askUserQuestions.q0: Stable identifier used to key the answer. Falls back to position.
askUserQuestions.q1: Question text shown above the options.
askUserQuestions.q2: 2–5 options to choose from. Omit for freeText questions.
askUserQuestions.q3: Allow multiple options to be selected. Adds a Next button at the bottom.
askUserQuestions.q4: Render an always-visible inline textarea for free-form, multi-line answers. Enter submits (single-select); Shift+Enter inserts a newline.
askUserQuestions.q6: Show the Skip control in the header.
askUserQuestions.q7: Label for the Next button in multi-select mode. Defaults to 'Next' or 'Finish'.
askUserQuestions.q8: Row layout. 'stacked' places the description on its own line under the title — use when descriptions are long enough to wrap.
askUserQuestions.q9: Which side of the row the numbered chip sits on. With 'left', the single-select submit arrow still appears on the row's right edge. Works with single/multi-select, allowOther, and inline/stacked layouts.
askUserQuestions.q10: Render a single multi-line textarea as the only answer — no option rows. The field auto-focuses; ⌘/⌃+Enter or the bottom submit button commits, and the answer is returned in otherText. Distinct from allowOther (which appends a free-text row alongside options); options is ignored when set.
askUserQuestions.q12: Whether the freeText field starts at multi-line height. Set false for a single-line field where plain Enter submits instead of inserting a newline. The textarea still grows to fit longer content either way.
askUserQuestions.q13: Validate the freeText value on submit. Return an error message to block submission and show it in the footer; return null to allow. The error clears as the user edits.
askUserQuestions.o0: Stable identifier returned in the answer. Falls back to position.
askUserQuestions.o1: Bold leading label for the option.
askUserQuestions.o2: Secondary muted text shown after the title.
askUserQuestions.a0: Id of the question this answer belongs to.
askUserQuestions.a1: Selected option ids. Length 0–1 in single-select, 0–N in multi-select.
askUserQuestions.a2: Free-form text from the Other input or a freeText question, if any.
askUserQuestions.a3: True when the user skipped the question.
